SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.barcode AS barcode, g.name AS name, g.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, u.name AS unitName, g.spec AS spec, g.is_weighed AS isWeighed, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(inv.cost_price, 0) AS costPrice, COALESCE(inv.cost_amount, 0) AS costAmount, g.retail_price AS retailPrice, g.safety_stock_lower AS safetyStockLower, g.safety_stock_upper AS safetyStockUpper, CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN 'OUT' WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) >= g.safety_stock_upper THEN 'OVERSTOCK' WHEN COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS stockStatus, inv.last_change_time AS lastChangeTime FROM goods g JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = g.unit_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id
ORDER BY
g.goods_code g.name COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) COALESCE(inv.cost_amount, 0) inv.last_change_time inv.last_change_time
ASC DESC
, g.id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inv.cost_amount), 0) FROM goods g LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (goods_id, store_id, quantity, cost_price, cost_amount, last_change_time, version) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{storeId}, 0, 0, 0, NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE goods_id = goods_id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + #{qty}, cost_amount = ROUND((quantity + #{qty}) * cost_price, 2), last_change_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND store_id = #{storeId}

UPDATE inventory SET quantity = #{quantity}, cost_price = #{costPrice}, cost_amount = #{costAmount}, last_change_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND store_id = #{storeId}
